## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly identifies the original target as minimality of both families, not an adjacent transition identity. The distinction between the original flag-variety ideal and its Grassmannian contraction must remain explicit.
- claim-2: Adequately grounded at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]. It proves only the lower-adjoined family over \(\mathbb Z\).
- claim-3: Adequately grounded at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 819-831] and completes lower-family minimality.
- claim-4: Correct. The conditional wording “could” at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840] is not a proof of right-family minimality.
- claim-5: This is the decisive implication, but its ledger status remains unsupported. A complete audit must explicitly define the conjugate tuple
  \[
  r^\vee=q,\qquad t^\vee=q-i+1,\qquad s^\vee=q-i+j,
  \]
  prove its bigrassmannian admissibility, derive
  \[
  (i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b),
  \]
  and verify basiswise the ideal and family maps. Merely referencing accepted task objectives does not expose these checks for fresh adversarial review.
- claim-6: Correct relative to the supplied record: no dependency-closed independent review of claim-5 is present. Thus the strategy has a strong conditional proof but does not yet satisfy the closure criterion. The transfer back from the Grassmannian contraction to the original ideal must also invoke [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-211].

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Produce one standalone independent conjugation certificate: from the original inequalities prove admissibility of \((r^\vee,s^\vee,t^\vee,n)=(q,q-i+j,q-i+1,n)\); compute \((i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b)\); prove integrally and basiswise that \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\), \(\omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\), and \(\omega(G_R(v))=G_L(v^\vee)\); handle \(a=0\); transfer generation and irredundancy through the ring isomorphism; and finally apply [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-211]. Return either a dependency-closed pass or one exact failing implication.

## Required revisions
- **Requested target status: not established in the current immutable record.** Only the lower-family theorem is source-established; the right-family conclusion remains conditional on the unsupported reviewed implication.
- Do not treat [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840] as a proof.
- Omit transition matrices, Hilbert series, pairings, and finite computations from the closure argument; none is required for the original minimality statement.
